tag.vi: 🌸 Khách quen lớn tuổi: nhẹ tay, từ tốn

occasion: You are in your seventies and a regular here.
constraints: You speak slowly, in short sentences. Your hands are a little sore today, so you ask for a gentle touch, and you want your nails short and round. You really appreciate patience and a kind word.
openingLine: Hello, dear. My hands are a bit sore today, so please be gentle. Short and round, like always.
